topics.label: Introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This opening introduces the lecture topic and outlines the expected learning outcomes for cancer therapy.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and systemic limitations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover conventional cancer treatment modalities and their associated therapeutic limitations.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic vulnerabilities and genetic defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss therapeutic strategies that selectively exploit intrinsic biological vulnerabilities and repair defects in cancer cells.

topics.label: Kinase inhibitors, oncogene addiction, and resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the design, clinical implementation, and resistance mechanisms associated with small-molecule kinase inhibitors targeting oncogenic driver mutations.

topics.label: Targeted monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe therapeutic strategies utilizing engineered antibodies to target cancer cell surface antigens and deliver cytotoxic payloads.

topics.label: Cancer immunotherapy and immune system engagement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore cancer immunology and therapeutic strategies designed to engage and enhance host immune responses against tumors.

topics.label: Clinical challenges, historical trends, and future directions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics reflect on broad historical trends, systemic challenges, and clinical dilemmas shaping the future of cancer treatment.
